capability: Apps made by the platform's company: extensions the platform's company makes, sells and supports, in a category of its own in the platform's marketplace (WooCommerce Developed by Woo, Woo extensions)
note: WooCommerce gives it a marketplace category of its own, Extensions > Developed by Woo (WC-C-050/where/WC-S-0697), the dry run's test for a capability. Its parent is CM-APP-002 because the category sits under the Marketplace's Extensions (the category's own path). Shopify's apps made by Shopify (SH-C-156/responsible/SH-S-0738, cited as shows in CM-APP-001) are for the back-fill to read.

capability: Marketplace connection: linking the store to the platform's marketplace account, so that the merchant installs extensions from it, receives their updates and support, and manages their subscriptions from the admin (WooCommerce Connection to WooCommerce.com, Advanced > WooCommerce.com, wccom-site/v3)
note: WooCommerce gives it a settings section (Advanced > WooCommerce.com, WC-S-0027) and an API group (wccom-site/v3, WC-S-0085) of their own. A store the platform hosts, as on Shopify and Salla, may need no such link; whether the anchors show one is for the back-fill.

capability: API response caching: the platform caches its API's responses, under a setting of its own (WooCommerce Advanced > REST API caching, rest_api_caching)
note: WooCommerce gives it a settings section of its own (WC-S-0024). Its feature flag is experimental and off by default (WC-S-5414).
